fusions.name: Notch by Notch
fusions.desc: A short chop with a flint edge that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Shattering Hatchet
fusions.desc: Hurls a hatchet of knapped flint that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts into shards that hit every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% as much.

fusions.name: Whetstone Stroke
fusions.desc: You hone the edge on stone for 1 second, then deal 30% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Knapped Edge
fusions.desc: Conjures an axe-head of knapped flint. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
